freeze: LOCAL_PRECALCULATION_NOT_EXTERNAL_PREREGISTRATION; analytic failure mechanism identified before computation
purpose: Derive coupled finite variations and test the additional interpretation of a regulated kinematic kernel as closed-system evolution
carrier: fixed N strict posets with fixed marked initial/final antichains; every free element lies between at least one initial/final element; no 4D selection
gravity: full unsmeared BDG4 at fixed N; Lambda=0; S_outer=0 is a candidate choice, not a derived continuum boundary term
matter: T on all elements; w=v4*rho>=0; Gamma=1/2*(B(T^2)-2T*BT+T^2*B1); S_d=-1/2 sum w*(Gamma+1)

measure.geometry: arbitrary labeled counting / allowed internal permutation group size
measure.density: nu(dw)=1/2 delta_0 + 1/(2*wmax) 1_(0,wmax)dw independently on free weights
measure.sector_weights: fixed N only; no variable-N law
measure.physical_status: model assumptions, not derived physical measure

variations.geometry: single relation toggle only if strict order and fixed boundary data are preserved; includes all affected BDG and matter intervals
variations.T: continuous free-clock variations, vanishing on fixed external data
variations.w: continuous variations in positive-density stratum; zero atom handled as distinct support stratum
variations.support: sum over density support patterns; no invented derivative of a binary mask
variations.quantum: finite-box integration-by-parts includes endpoint terms; geometry change-of-variables identity alone is not a field equation

algebra_tests.carrier_note: all posets for algebraic implementation checks, broader than the amplitude carrier

exterior_response.scope: conditional stationary auxiliary-clock response at fixed geometry/density; not a physical vacuum metric

normalization_test.gravity_phase: arbitrary common phase; cancels from K^dagger K
normalization_test.boundary_inner_products: I_2 on both declared finite kinematic boundary spaces
normalization_test.necessary_condition: K^dagger K=c I with one state/source-independent c>0; closed-time-path Z[J,J]=1 after fixed normalization
normalization_test.not_claimed: physical Hilbert space, complete continuum boundary basis, or a no-go for constrained amplitudes

decision_rules.nonisometric_kernel: reject raw-kernel evolution prescription in declared finite boundary spaces; do not infer failure of CST or of a possible constraint/projector interpretation
decision_rules.effective_causal_junction: HOLD unless quantum realization and classical first-variation/refinement bridge are qualified
